broad_core_role: universal candidate generator and general ranker; never counted as an expert

families.role: structure, catalytic pocket and reaction-mechanism evidence
families.pocket_role: applicability/confidence evidence; missing pocket is absence of evidence, never negative evidence
families.missing_policy: available members only; silent if none

families.role: named enzyme-family or local biochemical-domain expertise
families.automatic_router: hard domain applicability first; learned strength allowed only with independent family train/validation data

router.stage1: predict whether a general expert family should speak
router.stage2: predict bounded nonnegative query-specific residual strength
router.training_target: per-query oracle weight pair on frozen [0,.10,.20,.35,.50,.75]^2 grid; ties prefer less expert mass
inputs: cached pocket support at several shortlist depths
train-only PCA of Broad reaction embedding

ablation_contract.expensive_scoring: materialize each expert-family score once per query/candidate shortlist
ablation_contract.leave_one_family_out: offline reranking from the same frozen score cache
ablation_contract.test_suite: the complete frozen seven-cell broad suite, not a reduced 256-query subset
ablation_contract.domain_specialist: separate independent-domain evaluation until leakage-safe automatic applicability supervision is complete
